text:
ITEM 1 | Chopped raw vegetable salad on left half of plate: diced cucumber pieces (pale green with dark green skin edges, about 1 cm cubes), diced red bell pepper pieces (bright red, ~1 cm), yellow corn kernels scattered throughout, and shredded pale green-yellow leafy lettuce strands piled in a loose mound; moist, glossy, with light dressing sheen, spread over about 25% of plate area, roughly 5 cm tall at the center | 110
ITEM 2 | Shredded cooked meat mixture on right side of plate, covering about 30% of plate: pale grey-brown stringy pieces with fibrous texture, mixed with dark green leafy bits, small orange-red diced pieces, and yellow-green bits; some pieces show light browning and slight dryness, mound about 3 cm tall, sitting alongside a separate pile of white fluffy cooked grain (rice-like clumps, matte, about 1.5 cm high) on top-right edge | 150
ITEM 3 | White fluffy cooked grain clumps (rice-like, matte, opaque white with slight grain separation) on upper-right portion of the meat mound, roughly 6 cm across and 1.5 cm tall | 60
